name: claude-code-skills
description: Inspect, query, and export Claude Code sessions from ~/.claude/. Three skills: core (shared utilities), inspector (list/query sessions), and exporter (AgentLog + ASI output).

interface.shortDescription: Inspect and export Claude Code sessions
interface.longDescription: Three skills for working with Claude Code's ~/.claude/ session data: inspection (list, query, subagents, tools, history), export (raw JSONL + AgentLog v0.2.0 + ASI v1), and shared utilities.
defaultPrompt: Export this Claude Code session to AgentLog
